section.content: 本实用新型公开了恒温箱技术领域的一种生物基因用基因培养用恒温箱，包括本体、固定板、安装槽、联动机构和调节杆，所述固定板固定连接在所述本体的内腔左右侧壁上侧，所述安装槽开在所述固定板的内部左右两侧，所述联动机构固定安装在所述安装槽的内腔，所述调节杆转动连接在所述固定板的前侧壁，且延伸至安装槽的内腔，所述本体的顶部转动连接有保温盖，所述本体的内腔底部固定连接有缓冲板，该生物基因用基因培养用恒温箱，结构设计合理，能够对基因培养试管进行固定和保护，从而在打开关闭保温盖或搬运恒温箱的过程中，试管不易晃动，维持原有原有的静态环境，便于生物基因的培养，避免了实验的失败。

The utility model discloses a gene culture incubator for biological genes, which belongs to the technical field of incubators and comprises a body, a fixed plate, mounting grooves, a linkage mechanism and an adjusting rod, wherein the fixed plate is fixedly connected to the upper sides of the left side wall and the right side wall of an inner cavity of the body, the mounting grooves are formed in the left side and the right side of the inner part of the fixed plate, the linkage mechanism is fixedly mounted in the inner cavity of the mounting groove, the adjusting rod is rotatably connected to the front side wall of the fixed plate and extends to the inner cavity of the mounting groove, the top of the body is rotatably connected with a heat preservation cover, the bottom of the inner cavity of the body is fixedly connected with a buffer plate, the incubator for biological genes is reasonable in structural design and can fix and protect a gene culture test tube, so that the test tube is not easy to shake in the process of opening and closing the heat preservation cover or carrying the incubator, and the original static environment is maintained, the culture of biological genes is convenient, and the failure of experiments is avoided.

Incubator for gene culture for biological genesTechnical Field

The utility model relates to the technical field of biological gene thermostats, in particular to a thermostat for gene culture for biological genes.

Background

Box-type apparatus for raising or culturing living things or parts of living things (cells, etc.) at a certain temperature, most of experimental apparatus is of electric heating type, is provided with an electric heater and a temperature regulator, and is a box or a cabinet with heat insulating materials on the outer wall;

at present, current thermostated container lacks fixing device when holding the gene culture test tube, opens and closes the heat preservation lid and in the handling, can produce and rock, destroys original static environment to influence biological gene's cultivation, lead to the failure of experiment, for this reason we provide a thermostated container for gene culture for biological gene.

SUMMERY OF THE UTILITY MODEL

The utility model aims to provide a gene culture incubator for biological genes, which solves the problem that the existing incubator lacks a fixing device when being used for accommodating a gene culture test tube, and can shake and damage the original static environment during the processes of opening and closing an insulation cover and carrying so as to influence the culture of the biological genes.

In order to achieve the purpose, the utility model provides the following technical scheme: the utility model provides a thermostated container is used in gene culture for biological gene, includes body, fixed plate, mounting groove, link gear and regulation pole, the fixed plate fixed connection be in lateral wall upside about the inner chamber of body, the mounting groove is opened the inside left and right sides of fixed plate, link gear fixed mounting is in the inner chamber of mounting groove, it connects to adjust the pole rotation the preceding lateral wall of fixed plate, and extend to the inner chamber of mounting groove, the top of body is rotated and is connected with the lid that keeps warm, the inner chamber bottom fixedly connected with buffer board of body.

Preferably, it has the display screen to inlay in the middle of the top rear side of heat preservation lid, it has the hasp to inlay in the middle of the preceding lateral wall of heat preservation lid, the top four corners of buffer board has all opened the spacing groove, the inner chamber bottom bonding of spacing groove has the sponge piece.

Preferably, the top four corners of fixed plate all opens there is the fixed orifices, it has the spout to open in the middle of the inside wall right side of fixed orifices, the inner chamber sliding connection of spout has the slider.

Preferably, the front side wall of the inner cavity of the mounting groove is provided with a connecting groove and penetrates through the fixing plate.

Preferably, the link gear includes first kicking block, connecting block, elastic component, gangbar, fixed block and second kicking block, the gangbar runs through sliding connection and is in the inner chamber of fixed block, elastic component fixed connection is in the rear side wall of fixed block, and is located the outside of gangbar, connecting block fixed connection be in the lateral wall rear side of gangbar, and with the terminal fixed connection of elastic component, first kicking block fixed connection be in the rear end of gangbar, second kicking block fixed connection be in the front end of gangbar, the inside wall fixed connection of fixed block and mounting groove.

Preferably, a first screw thread is arranged on the front side of the outer side wall of the adjusting rod, a second screw thread is arranged on the rear side of the outer side wall of the adjusting rod, and the tail end of the adjusting rod is rotatably connected with the front side wall of the second ejecting block through a rotating shaft.

Compared with the prior art, the utility model has the beneficial effects that: the thermotank for gene culture for biological genes drives the linkage rod to move by pulling the adjusting rod, so that the first ejector block and the second ejector block move towards the outer side of the fixed plate, the first ejector block is separated from the rear side sliding block and can move in the rear side sliding groove, the second ejector block is separated from the front side sliding block and can move in the front side sliding groove, a test tube can be conveniently placed in the fixed hole, the linkage rod is driven to reset under the action of the rebound force of the elastic piece by releasing the adjusting rod, the sliding block is pushed to move towards the left side of the sliding groove to fix the test tube, the independent fixation of the adjusting rod during opening and closing is convenient through the first screw teeth and the second screw teeth, the thermotank for gene culture for biological genes does not need to be held by hands of a worker, the operation is convenient, the stability of the test tube during fixing is improved through the limiting groove on the buffer plate, so that the test tube is not easy to shake in the process of opening and closing the heat preservation cover or carrying the thermotank, original static environment is maintained, the culture of biological genes is convenient, and the failure of experiments is avoided.

Detailed Description

The utility model provides a gene culture incubator for biological genes, which can fix a culture test tube and improve the success rate of an experiment, and please refer to fig. 1-3, and the incubator comprises a body 100, a fixing plate 200, a mounting groove 300, a linkage mechanism 400 and an adjusting rod 500;

referring to fig. 1-2, the top of the body 100 is rotatably connected with a heat-insulating cover 110, the bottom of the inner cavity of the body 100 is fixedly connected with a buffer plate 120, the body 100 is used for mounting a fixing plate 200, the heat-insulating cover 110 is used for heat insulation of the body 100, and the buffer plate 120 is used for protecting a test tube;

referring to fig. 2-3, the fixing plate 200 is fixedly connected to the upper sides of the left and right side walls of the inner cavity of the body 100, and the fixing plate 200 is used for placing test tubes;

referring to fig. 3, the mounting grooves 300 are formed at left and right sides of the inside of the fixing plate 200, and the mounting grooves 300 are used for mounting the link mechanism 400;

referring to fig. 3 again, the linkage mechanism 400 is fixedly installed in the inner cavity of the installation groove 300, specifically, the linkage mechanism 400 is fixedly connected to the middle of the inner side wall of the installation groove 300 through the fixing block 450, and the linkage mechanism 400 is used for power transmission;

referring to fig. 3 again, the adjusting rod 500 is rotatably connected to the front side wall of the fixing plate 200 and extends to the inner cavity of the mounting groove 300, and the adjusting rod 500 is used for controlling the movement of the linkage rod 440.

Referring to fig. 1-2 again, in order to observe the real-time temperature of the incubator, a display screen 111 is embedded in the middle of the rear side of the top of the heat-insulating cover 110, a lock catch 112 is embedded in the middle of the front side wall of the heat-insulating cover 110, limiting grooves 121 are formed in four corners of the top of the buffer plate 120, and a sponge block 122 is bonded to the bottom of the inner cavity of the limiting groove 121.

Referring to fig. 2-3 again, in order to facilitate the placement of the test tube, four corners of the top of the fixing plate 200 are all provided with fixing holes 210, the middle of the right side of the inner side wall of the fixing hole 210 is provided with a sliding groove 211, and the inner cavity of the sliding groove 211 is slidably connected with a sliding block 212.

Referring to fig. 3 again, in order to facilitate the installation of the linkage mechanism 400, the front side wall of the inner cavity of the installation slot 300 is opened with a connection slot 310 penetrating through the fixing plate 200.

Referring to fig. 3 again, in order to facilitate power transmission, the linkage mechanism 400 includes a first top block 410, a connection block 420, an elastic member 430, a linkage rod 440, a fixed block 450, and a second top block 460, the linkage rod 440 penetrates through an inner cavity of the fixed block 450 in a sliding manner, the elastic member 430 is fixedly connected to a rear side wall of the fixed block 450 and is located outside the linkage rod 440, the connection block 420 is fixedly connected to a rear side of an outer side wall of the linkage rod 440 and is fixedly connected to a terminal of the elastic member 430, the first top block 410 is fixedly connected to a rear end of the linkage rod 440, the second top block 460 is fixedly connected to a front end of the linkage rod 440, and the fixed block 450 is fixedly connected to an inner side wall of the mounting groove 300.

Referring to fig. 3 again, in order to facilitate the control of the linkage rod 440, a first thread 510 is formed on the front side of the outer sidewall of the adjustment rod 500, a second thread 520 is formed on the rear side of the outer sidewall of the adjustment rod 500, and the end of the adjustment rod 500 is rotatably connected to the front sidewall of the second ejection block 460 through a rotation shaft.

When the test tube fixing device is used specifically, a person skilled in the art can rotate the adjusting rod 500 to separate the first thread teeth 510 from the thread grooves of the connecting groove 310, so that the adjusting rod 500 can move in the connecting groove 310, the adjusting rod 500 is directly pulled to drive the linkage rod 440 of the linkage mechanism 400 to move through the adjusting rod 500, so that the first ejecting block 410 and the second ejecting block 460 move towards the outside of the fixing plate 200, the elastic member 430 is compressed to drive the first ejecting block 410 to separate from the rear side sliding block 212, so that the first ejecting block 410 can move in the rear side sliding groove 211, the second ejecting block 460 is separated from the front side sliding block 212, so that the second ejecting block 460 can move in the front side sliding groove 211, so as to place a test tube in the fixing hole 210, the linkage rod 500 is driven to reset under the reverse elasticity of the elastic member 430 by releasing the adjusting rod 440, the sliding block 212 is pushed to move towards the left side of the sliding groove 211, so as to fix the test tube, and the first thread teeth 510 and the second thread teeth 520, be convenient for to the regulation pole 500 alone fixed when opening and closing, need not be hand all the time, the operation of being convenient for, through spacing groove 121 on the buffer board 120, be convenient for improve the stability of test tube in fixing, can protect the bottom of test tube through sponge piece 122.
